name: 5i5j Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: 5i5j Holding Group Co., Ltd. provides real estate brokerage services in China and internationally. It provides brokerage business, such as buying, selling, and leasing of existing homes; property registration, verification, display, and inquiry, as well as professional consultation and matching transaction; and online services for verification, signing, fulfillment, and customer support services. The company also offers asset management business, including housing rental management business; new home sales; commercial leasing and services, comprising commercial leasing and services; and asset management services.
